items.question: How does one now wish to hear the auspicious deception of time?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear.
The object is the auspicious deception of time.
items.inference: The verse frames the teaching as a timely request to learn time's auspicious deception.
uncertainties: Whether vañcanaṃ is object of śrotum or part of a larger compound phrase.
items.plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.

items.question: How is death destroyed without doubt according to this teaching?
premises: The speaker says there is no doubt.
Death is destroyed in the manner described.
items.inference: The verse assures that the described practice destroys death without doubt.
uncertainties: The exact manner of destruction is supplied by surrounding verses.
items.plain_english: I tell you without doubt: death is destroyed.
